title: Our AI, Your Problem
summary: The debate over whether European firms should use a Chinese state-directed model or one built by a private US firm threatens to distract from Europe’s most pressing problem, which is that it has no seat at either table. To preserve its own sovereignty, the continent must create a third option for itself.

title: Chile’s Boring Conservative President
summary: Rather than governing like a pugnacious populist or a ruthless pragmatist, Chile’s new president, José Antonio Kast, has adopted an old-school center-right agenda and governing style reminiscent of the 1980s. Yet even this potentially safer approach comes with its own risks and costs.
